Remaining downstream margin48 and asset12 produce first-half profit27; NCI receives4.2 from subsidiary legal profit.

The July unchanged-control purchase removes NCI12.1 and parent equity7.9, preserving earlier earnings allocation. External sale reverses margin48 and tax12; annual group profit102, parent equity708.75, NCI15.25 and external cash644 reconcile without a balancing plug.

Fiscal boundaries, probable recovery, rate remeasurement, use and expiry are explained through the same P/S balances. Rate benefit2, reversal12 and new asset9 yield deferred expense1. Supported versus zero recognition changes profit timing; missing evidence stays unresolved. The terminal unused loss20 remains an expired right, and legal offset conditions are explicit.

The bank/insurer group begins from supplied control and matching deposit identities rather than adding component funding as new legal capital. Only its opening and start of the loan schedule have been read; no complete sector-section judgment is recorded. No new confirmed defect or clipping was observed in this segment.
